items.title: Mike Vax interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 29, 2022
items.q: from the back of the bus Al Porcino, who always talked very slow, he said, “Why don’t you try swinging?”

ctx.x: And this ain’t the “Woodchopper’s Ball” here.

And then one time they were having some discussion with some of the musicians and Stan is saying, “I got certain ideas that I want this band to do and it isn’t a matter of swing. It isn’t a matter of coming from the old big band and the dance bands. It’s a matter of being a concert jazz orchestra” And I guess this was on the bus or something and from the back of the bus Al Porcino, who always talked very slow, he said, “Why don’t you try swinging?” You know but Stan, of all the leaders, Stan knew what he wanted.…
stuff that, in the Kenton way, swings its butt off. You know I mean just the change was phenomenal.
